profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU, with SEC CIK 0000723125. Its website describes it as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. The site's own material points to product data sheets, design tools and technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program (TEP), sample ordering, and sales support, and it says mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive and insightful experiences for end users.

Held facts add little beyond that. No products are tracked, no lawsuits are listed, and no MCP servers are recorded. The profile does list 21 legal matters in Idaho.
